02:49 -!- Filip [Filip@193.190.11.245] has joined #linux4be
02:50  * Filip looks around 
03:08 -!- antagonizt [~johnbot@tnt1-71.ghg.net] has joined #Linux4BE
03:09  * antagonizt looks around
03:14 < Filip> morning antagonizt
03:14 < antagonizt> very early morning
03:14 < antagonizt> how are things going?
03:15 < antagonizt> i want to start helping out again but i'm still not settled in here in houston
03:15 < Filip> still rather busy, but it's slowly calming down a bit
03:15 < Filip> Brian (sinfonian)is also living in Houston
03:16 < antagonizt> ahh maybe he has a scoop on the job market here?
03:20 < Filip> I've looked a bit into the IRQ stuff again , and it looks like it's cacscasded from the one used the CF/ATA patch
03:21 < antagonizt> so we need a low level dispatcher function?
03:22 < Filip> Brian should indeed now his way around 
03:23 < Filip> yes, a low level dispatcher, and need to find a way to decide determine the source of the interrupt
03:23 < antagonizt> haven't found a flags reg or some such thing?
03:23 < Filip> I think it's also the reason why the CF patch gives all these unexpected interrupt messages
03:24 < Filip> it's trying to handle interrupts which are triggered by touchscreen/buttons/....
03:25 < antagonizt> makes sense
03:25 < Filip> that's next on my list: see if i can find a way  to determine the exact source...
03:28 < Filip> so you're looking for a job now ?
03:28 < antagonizt> do the msgs show up specifically when btns are pressed?
03:30 < Filip> I had them show up both on touchscreen and button activity, and when serial is attached they keep coming
03:31 < Filip> probably because the error message is going out over serial, triggering a new interrupt, giving another error, .... creating a loop
04:09 < antagonizt> good night
